devdoc.details: This is for the first version of the PSM.         Code: https://github.com/makerdao/dss-psm/blob/222c96d4047e76680ed6803f07dd61aa2590e42b/src/psm.sol

redeemAndSwap(address,uint256,uint256).details: Please note that this will leave dust due to rounding error in this contract.

params.minAmountOut: The minimum amount of `gem` to receive.
params.shares: The amount of shares to redeem.

swapAndDeposit(address,uint256,uint256).details: Please note that `minAmountOut` is measured in `dai` due to increasing value of the `savingsToken`.         `minAmountOut` is used to protect in the case PSM fees change.

params.amountIn: The amount of the `gem` to swap.
params.minAmountOut: The minimum amount of `dai` to receive.

returns.amountOut: The amount of `dai` deposited into the `savingsToken`.

withdrawAndSwap(address,uint256,uint256).details: Please note that `maxAmountIn` is measured in `dai` due to increasing value of the `savingsToken`.         `maxAmountIn` is used to protect in the case PSM fees change.

params.amountOut: The amount of `gem` you want to receive.
params.maxAmountIn: The maximum amount of `dai` to pay for this swap.

returns.amountIn: The amount of `dai` used for the swap.

redeemAndSwap(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Redeem a specified amount of `savingsToken` from the `savingsToken` for `dai` and swap for `gem` in the PSM.         Use this if you want to withdraw everything.

swapAndDeposit(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Swap `gem` for `dai` in the PSM and deposit in the `savingsToken`.

withdrawAndSwap(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Withdraw a specified amount of output `gem` with a maximum limit of `savingsToken` (in DAI units).         Use this if you want an exact amount of `gem` tokens out. IE pay someone 10k exactly.

userdoc.notice: Actions for swapping in PSM and depositing in an ERC4626 token.
